points.text: Core idea (LLM table extraction + text-to-SQL) close to Evaporate and text-to-table work; limited novelty
Related work dismisses Evaporate; no comparison with Evaporate or similar systems
Missing agentic, code-based, iterative or map-reduce aggregation baselines
Headline results use oracle gold schema built with test questions in view
Realistic InferredSchema variant scores poorly, below baselines on FB-Agg
Claim of strong results versus top RAG methods is overstated
Manual schema construction effort unmeasured; scaling to real query distributions not shown
HOTELS documents verbalize structured records; extraction nearly inverts generation, favouring method
WORLD CUP is tiny (22 docs) and leaked into LLM pretraining
Datasets fit method assumptions (one schema, no nested/list); real unstructured corpora untested
Only 50 FB-Agg queries
No confidence intervals, seeds or significance tests
S-RAG uses GPT-4o while baselines use o3; generator confound
VectorRAG baseline is a single weak configuration without BM25 or reranker
Missing long-context model baselines (1M-token models)
Truncated FullCorpus does not support claim of outperforming long-context LLMs
OAI-Responses baseline is a black box with unspecified configuration
LLM judges unvalidated; no human agreement study
Judge prompt has no numeric tolerance
Answer Recall metric not described in detail
Bare-number vs long reasoning outputs may bias judge behaviour
WORLD CUP question count inconsistent (83 vs 88)
No quantified error analysis of failures
Record extraction accuracy and SQL execution accuracy not reported
No results broken down by question type
No ablations on schema-induction sample sizes, iterations, column statistics, hybrid mode
Ingestion cost (one LLM call per document) not discussed or compared
Hybrid gain over VectorRAG within noise and uses gold schema; general-purpose claim unsupported
Narrow scope: single schema, no list/nested attributes, joins or multi-entity; title overbroad
Hybrid mode under-described (document selection, empty SQL results)
Question generation under-specified; gold answers not validated by humans
Questions likely answerable by single SQL by construction; not analysed
Missing related work: LOTUS, Palimpzest, ZenDB, table-augmented generation
Not evaluated on cited aggregative benchmarks MoNaCo, QAMPARI, QUEST
Assumes all documents share one structure / single entity type
Performance on nested or list-type attributes unverified
Hotels and World Cup datasets small; large-scale scalability unvalidated
Implementation mostly prompting existing LLMs; minimal methodological innovation
No quantitative analysis of schema accuracy or inter-run variance; stability unclear
Different models for S-RAG (GPT-4o) and baselines (o3) confound comparisons
Synthetic LLM-generated HOTELS may bias in favour of schema-driven methods
LLM-as-judge metrics without agreement statistics or robustness analysis
No human evaluation of correctness
Single latent schema assumption; multi-schema or hierarchical settings unexplored
Hotels dataset generated from hand-crafted attributes, too structured; contradicts unstructured claim
Synthetic question-answer pairs not human-verified
Method straightforward; similar prior work (TrustUQA, QuASM)
Limited to single-entity-type corpora
Schema inference fragile; large gap between gold and inferred schemas
WORLD CUP 22 docs, HOTELS 350; far below enterprise scale
No timing or computational cost analysis of ingestion
Aggregative queries simple; no multi-join or nested aggregations
